construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)
candidate_note: LOCKED corpus ×50 (k2 cell 2026-08-19; chips and ledger 2026-09-04); k2_card registers remain an unauthored stub.
sources: REA_03 §4b (interaction seeds — parsed from the doc)

candidates.structural_interaction: Metal directing Wood broadly — precision ranging across living material
candidates.k2_overview: Your Wood moves as the Horizon: growth that reaches for distant light. Opportunity, for you, is territory: new markets, new cities, branches extended where no one from home has grown. You expand naturally and prune reluctantly. Fortune arrives through the reaching. Roots decide how much of it you keep.
candidates.k2_functional: You grow toward opportunity steadily, extending reach every season without retreating.

k2_domain_readings.Opportunity: Opportunities appear to you as open land: markets unplanted, niches unclaimed. You see fertile ground others call wilderness. Scout it, but check the soil before transplanting everything.
k2_domain_readings.Ventures: Your ventures grow in groves: several trunks sharing a root system of skills and contacts. Let each mature before seeding the next. Orchards fail from planting fever, not planting.
k2_domain_readings.Father: The father-thread runs green and rangy: reach, enterprise, restlessness, wherever a paternal figure stood. Where that reaching shaped you, keep it. Where it left no roots, plant them yourself.

angles.drive: Spotting openings is what you do before anything is obvious. Carrying less Wood than drive to spend, you spot the far chance sooner than the one in your hand. Half the good ideas in your circle started as something you pointed at.
angles.cost_self: Where you spot openings is always past where you stand. Wanting freedom more than settling, you spot what is far instead of taking what is near. Good things within reach go by while you look further out.
angles.cost_others: You point out the openings you spot to anyone beside you. Because the far chance holds you more than the near one, you spot the next before finishing this with them. Your partners get half of your mind on the shared work.

angles.drive: Starting comes easily to you, often before you finish deciding. Moving is how you feel alive, so you start and learn rather than wait until you are sure. Whole projects exist because you went first while others were still talking.
angles.cost_self: Whenever something new opens, you start before asking what it needs. Because starting feels like freedom, you take the quick start ahead of the rest you are owed. Your life fills with things you began and never saw through.
angles.cost_others: Whatever you start has other people in it before the thing is real. You need movement more than certainty, so you start, move on and leave the middle open. The slow work of finishing falls to whoever came along with you.

angles.drive: Generosity comes more easily to you than keeping, especially money. Being generous makes the world feel wide, so you give away a good month rather than save it. More than one friend got through a hard year with your help.
angles.cost_self: Giving is your first answer to most things. Since being generous feels more like you than being careful, you give the extra ahead of putting any aside. Your savings stay thin through even the best years.
angles.cost_others: Whenever the people close to you run short, you are generous before being asked. Because being generous keeps you freer than being owed, you give rather than build anything shared. Nobody near you goes without for long.

angles.drive: Whatever is newest in front of you is what you chase hardest. With more Wood than strength under it, you chase the fresh start ahead of the finish. You leave a row of half-done things behind you, each one new when you started.
angles.cost_self: Where you are is rarely what you chase. Because staying feels like being stuck rather than home, you chase the far plan with hours the near one needed. You lose the venture already begun to each new chase, and half of one pays nothing.
angles.cost_others: Chasing the next thing keeps you alive. Since a new chance pulls more than the one in hand, you chase it and leave the unfinished half to your partner. You keep the start of a shared plan and hand your partner the long middle.

angles.drive: Spreading yourself over several things feels normal, and one alone feels like being caught. Your Wood outruns the strength carrying it, so you spread across every open option rather than drop one. You wanted freedom all along, and a closed option leaves it whole.
angles.cost_self: You are spread among more things than your body keeps up with. Because letting go feels like losing rather than choosing, you spread yourself over them, tired at each one. Spread this thin, you never get a full rest and start each day already tired.
angles.cost_others: Whenever something new asks for you, you spread yourself one slice thinner. Since closing an option feels like losing, you keep spreading rather than shut one. You hand your partner and family the same thin slice as everything else.

angles.drive: Unspent money feels less real to you than money already gone. Spending keeps life open, so you spend an easy month rather than put any toward a slow one. Spending for freedom, you meet the slow month with none of it left.
angles.cost_self: With money, you spend sooner than you let it sit. Since spending feels like living and saving like waiting, you spend the whole month ahead of keeping any. You pay for the free spending with savings you never get to keep.
angles.cost_others: Spending on the people near you comes before your own next month. Because helping them out feels better than keeping, you spend on their short weeks rather than a shared cushion. You spend their quiet months as well as your own.

edge.lead: Wood runs through your wealth, your family and your social life. It is the opening you see before the sign is up, the hand at home that gives before anyone asks, and the trip your friends still weigh while you are already packed.
